entities.summary: Eve Frank or Eva Frank born Rachel Frank in Nikopol, Ottoman Empire, was a mystic cult leader, and the only woman to have been declared a Jewish messiah according to historian Jerry Rabow. She was the daughter of Jacob Frank.
